primary_releases.name: Eli Lilly
primary_releases.body_excerpt: Let’s share the care Caregiving too often falls on one person. Find one thing you can take off their plate. November 25, 2026 This holiday season, let’s take something off a caregiver’s plate. In many families, one person spends the whole year taking care of everything: the appointments, the paperwork, the late-night calls, the worry. A comedy sketch got the world talking about it. Thousands of you declared, "I am Sister." Many of us at Lilly did too. Sister isn't always your sister. It can be a sibling, a partner or a friend. So as we gather around the table, let's do more than say thank you.
